XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault light on and "Have engine checked" warning with vehicle functioning correctly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0069 | P2227 | ON | LIGHTS UP | MIL | YELLOW | WORKS | WELL | SENSOR | PRESSURE | MANIFOLD | INTAKE | OPERATION | CORRECT | INDICATION | DISPLAY | DASHBOARD | INSTRUMENTS | SCREEN | SEES | DISPLAYED | COMES | OFF

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Intake manifold pressure sensor

  • Fault: The message ‘Have engine checked’ appears on the display and the engine fault warning light comes on; however, the vehicle continues to operate correctly

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • P0069 (Absolute pressure sensor/atmospheric pressure sensor – Incorrect ratio)
    • P2227 (Atmospheric pressure sensor – Incorrect performance/function)
  • Cause: Faulty intake manifold pressure sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the intake manifold pressure sensor and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the defective component is accessible from the top of the engine compartment, connected directly to the intake manifold, and shows no visual abnormalities.
    Malfunctions of the intake manifold pressure sensor are quite common in this engine
